title: SpaceX Pad Abort Test
summary: A short SpaceX video of the Dragon 2 pad abort test, in which the capsule's thrusters fire to carry it away from the launch pad. It also shows the pad deluge system.
why: HN commenters cite it as evidence that Dragon's built-in launch escape system works and that a failed launch need not kill the crew.

quote.text: SpaceX demo'ed their launch abort system
